sources.title: How My Predictions Are Faring — Ray Kurzweil
sources.locator: The Computer Itself, prediction 15, printed p. 23

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Task-oriented natural-language interfaces are broadly routine, including the forecast’s frequent animated-personality presentation.
reference.rationale: Language interfaces existed, but the retrospective concedes that they were not ubiquitous at the deadline. Siri and later assistants fulfill routine natural-language interaction. The recurring avatar/personality presentation is less fully realized, so the full compound remains partial.
